label: stockpile-area-grid-baseline
workload: cone R 40 m, H 12 m (analytic 20,106.2 m³) on a 100 m square apron at z = 0, points uniform over the apron; constant base at z = 0; 3 runs, best reported
reading: Under uniform density both estimators sit within 0.5% of the analytic cone; the grid's steady -0.15% is the median-per-cell surface on a curved peak at the derived cell size, a resolution term the result reports through cellSizeM. The grid costs 3 to 7 times the point-sample pass and stays near one second at 2 M selected points, which is the same order as the lasso walk that precedes it. The density-invariance property is pinned by tests, not by this uniform workload.
